notes.title: Version 1.0.3 comes with a sale!
notes.notes:
To celebrate our first month on Steam, we started the first sale of ACardShooter, which comes with the new version 1.0.3 which will provides new players an easier start into the game.

Changelog:
-Improved Tutorial System
-Adjustable Cursor Speed

notes.title: ACardShooter now released
notes.notes:
After almost one and a half years of work after the [url=https://ldjam.com/events/ludum-dare/41/a-card-shooter]Ludum Dare[/url], we have finally done it: ACardShooter is now publicly available on Steam!

You can read the full story [url=https://acardshooter.tumblr.com/]on our blog[/url].

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We've released a quick hotfix:
[list]
[*] Ensure players get achievement notifications
[*] Adjust overall music volume
[/list]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes: We are proud to finally announce the release date for ACardShooter. You can buy the game starting on the 16th of August!
